Because the voyage stake is held until the sonnet settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the spiral audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 43% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
